context:
Source: DataFrame query parity proposal v3 (item T3). If owner decision D1 chooses production scope, that is a separate item (dfparity-t22). Project owner does NOT accept earlier reviewers' TPC-H claims.

Findings 2026-10-02 (TESTED by bisecting develop; no code in this item yet). (1) The gate-side change is ALREADY LIVE: benchbox/core/equivalence/builders/tpcds.py renders the reference SQL with benchmark.get_queries(dialect="duckdb"), and PR #2509 (t22, merged) makes get_queries render at the data's scale, so the gate now renders at its scale; the 'runner.get_queries is unchanged' clause of the acceptance is superseded by owner decision D1. What remains: a builder-level test pinning that the gate renders at its scale, and D2's stream (default 0) threaded into the gate render (generate(stream_id=) does not select a stream, so stream-n SQL must come from DSQGenBinary.generate_with_parameters, PR #2510, fed with generate_parameter_log values; this only matters once parameters are bound, so it can ride with t04). (2) EFFECT OF #2509 (evidence/rev2/gate_tpcds_sf001_at_4e6e1bec5_8divergent.log): at SF 0.01 the SQL for Q9, Q44, Q46 and Q68 now carries SF 0.01 dsqgen values while the DataFrame defaults are SF>=1 values, so they diverge on both families (8 divergent cells): parameter drift exposed, to be fixed by t04 and t05, not DataFrame logic bugs. Q44 also left the classified-empty list's truth: it was classified empty at SF 0.01 only because it was rendered with SF=1 parameters, and with scale-aware rendering it returns rows (a stale entry in _TPCDS_LEGITIMATELY_EMPTY). (3) THE GATE ALREADY FAILED BEFORE #2509: the staged TPC-DS gate went from exit 0 (146 of 198 compared, 52 empty, 0 divergent at 9fcf78335 and d39166ea6) to exit 1 (134 compared, 64 vacuous, 0 divergent at d33ef35e5) at commit 68ce40abc (#2396, joinorder, which also edited cross_surface.py): it now treats a scalar aggregate that collapses to one all-NULL row as 0-row vacuous, which is right (None == None must not count as coverage), but six TPC-DS queries are exactly that (13, 23, 32, 61, 90, 92) and are not in _TPCDS_LEGITIMATELY_EMPTY, so the gate fails closed. The only consumer is the weekly report workflow tpcds-staged-maturation.yml, not a required check, so no merge is blocked. (4) EMPTY SETS BY THE GATE'S RULE (0 rows, or one all-NULL row; scripts/rev2/empty_set.py, evidence/rev2/empty_*.json), current develop: SF 0.01: 31 vacuous queries (3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 13, 23, 24, 31, 32, 37, 39, 41, 49, 53, 54, 55, 58, 61, 63, 64, 65, 73, 82, 83, 85, 90, 91, 92, 93), of which 6 are unclassified (13, 23, 32, 61, 90, 92) and 1 classified entry is no longer empty (44); SF 0.1: 23 vacuous (3, 8, 10, 13, 23, 24, 25, 29, 37, 41, 53, 54, 58, 63, 61, 64, 65, 73, 82, 85, 90, 91, 93). Emptiness is not monotonic in scale (for example 4, 6, 11, 31, 39, 49, 55, 83 are empty at 0.01 and not at 0.1; 25 and 29 the other way). Not fixed here: t19's rule forbids classifying an empty query before parameters match and the answer-set evidence exists, and the file is a soundness path (external review plus a maintainer merge); an owner decision is needed on an interim classification of the six.
description: Pass the gate's scale into the TPC-DS SQL render inside benchbox/core/equivalence/builders/tpcds.py only. Do NOT change runner.get_queries or any production path (see owner decision D1): production SQL runs at SF!=1 currently use SF=1 parameters and changing that alters baselines. About 10 templates use rowcount(...) so their dsqgen values depend on scale (Q44's differ at every other scale; tested). After rendering at the data's scale, _TPCDS_LEGITIMATELY_EMPTY (benchbox/core/equivalence/cross_surface.py ~1410, 26 entries, described as the bounded SF=0.01 cell) must be re-derived because emptiness is not monotonic in scale (23 queries are empty at some scales and not others).
